title: AFCAT 02/2026 Admit Card
vacancyDetails: AFCAT 02/2026 for Flying Branch and Ground Duty (Technical/Non-Technical) courses
qualification: Graduation / as per AFCAT 02/2026 notification for applied branch
ageLimit: As per AFCAT branch-wise age criteria
selectionProcess: AFCAT Online Exam → AFSB Interview → Medical
documentsRequired: Email ID / password for AFCAT login; printed admit card and photo ID for exam
howToApply:
1. Visit https://afcat.cdac.in
2. Login with registered email and password
3. Download AFCAT 02/2026 admit card
4. Print and verify centre, date and photo
5. Carry admit card + photo ID to exam
shortDescription: AFCAT 02/2026 Admit Card available. Download hall ticket from afcat.cdac.in.
content:
The Indian Air Force has released the AFCAT 02/2026 Admit Card for candidates who registered for the Air Force Common Admission Test.

Download the e-admit card only from the official AFCAT portal and check exam city, date, shift and reporting time carefully.
